description: This file defines CLI commands for system tools such as events, heartbeat, and presence, using the 'commander' library. It includes functions to register CLI commands, handle options, and invoke gateway RPC calls.

methods.name: normalizeWakeMode
methods.description: Normalizes the wake mode string, defaulting to 'next-heartbeat' and validating allowed values.

methods.name: runSystemGatewayCommand
methods.description: Executes a gateway command with error handling and output formatting based on options.

methods.name: registerSystemCli
methods.description: Registers 'system' CLI commands including 'event', 'heartbeat', and 'presence' with subcommands and options.
